Donor: hsoliwal/com.synexia develop 64652588f0d4c23b1f6e0411090b2a796325ae0e (Java owner commits 1c0f0843b21 2026-11-03 galloping, 94d22fee2e5 + 7a309c659e7 2026-11-04 counts, 94486a51a24 2026-11-06 superset align; C kernel commits b2f0199da3d / 35fb2ea3e2e 2026-11-02, 1c0f0843b21, 94d22fee2e5, 7a309c659e7).

# FILE rows: donor path (donor repository root) -> target path (module root m3/arrays). PACKAGE rows: donor package -> target package. TYPE rows: donor type -> target type (M3 naming). JNI rows: exported JNI symbol prefix of the donor class -> prefix of the relocated class (C files). INCLUDE rows: #include spec of the donor javac -h header -> the module's <jni.h>. DROP rows: donor path + sha256 of one exact donor line removed by declaration (the MAT capability-plan family is not relocated). EXTERNAL rows: third-party packages the donor imports, kept as they are (none here: java.util only).

# The C kernel is taken from the develop tree's retained variant m3/qualification/master-landing-20261028/retained-variants/pr15528/ (blob 9f301002dc, 572 lines, commit 7a309c659e7): it is the only kernel in the tree defining all seven natives the develop Java declares (nativeAbi, unionNative, intersectionNative, countUnionNative, countIntersectionNative, countUnionUpToNative, countIntersectionUpToNative) with the cursor-local galloping lower bound; the main-path synexia-mat-collections/native/mat_posting_merge.c (blob 781288b369, 415 lines) was reset to its 2026-11-02 version by the align commit 94486a51a24 and lacks galloping and the four count kernels (see README.md).
